lore: A thin book about very thin slabs.
use: The Simple Slabs Guide explains half slabs, the side half slab and how to cut them. Craft it shapeless from a book and a stone slab.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

use: Places in the clicked cell layer; the same half slab fills the free layer at the click. Sneak + right-click on a block side: upright, 4 layers = side slab. Cut 4 from a slab, 8 from the block; 4 craft back. Breaking drops one per layer.
secret: Eight layers fit into one cell, in any order: 0-4 plus 12-16 pixels is just layers 1, 2, 7 and 8. Sand and gravel half slabs fall, copper ones age.
